# Journal of Sports Science and Medicine (JSSM)

> > JSSM is a quarterly, peer-reviewed, open-access journal publishing research in sports science, sports medicine, and exercise science, indexed in SCI Expanded, SCOPUS, MEDLINE, and PubMed.

Published under the Budapest Open Access Initiative (BOAI), JSSM provides free access to cutting-edge research in athletic performance, training, rehabilitation, and sports medicine. The journal maintains rigorous peer-review standards and is affiliated with Uludag University, Turkey.

## Key Topics

- Sports Science
- Sports Medicine
- Exercise Science
- Open Access Publishing
- Peer Review
